title: UK CPI, April 2027 (ONS, 07:00 London / 02:00 ET) — the print the electricity-VAT attribution rule is supposed to be read on, and the month it is least readable in
source: EST: ons.gov.uk/releases/consumerpriceinflationukapril2027, fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200) — the ONS release page reads 'Consumer price inflation, UK: April 2027', '19 May 2027 7:00am', is labelled 'Provisional', and states 'This release is not yet published'. ONS's own label is Provisional, not Confirmed, which is the honest reason for `estimate` on top of the standing schema gap: market-events-data.ts's confirmed-prefix taxonomy (IR:/CAL:/BLS:/FED:/PJM:/SEC:/TSY:/OCC:/BEA:/CENSUS:/ISM:/CB:/UMICH:/FHFA:) has no slot for the UK Office for National Statistics. Re-verified independently of the proposing lane during the never-assessed initial research of this event, 2026-09-09
notes: CANONICAL FILE WRITTEN BY THE never-assessed INITIAL RESEARCH 2026-09-09, superseding proposals/uk-cpi-2027-05-19.from-uk-electricity-vat-reversion-2027-04-01.json (read in full first per docs/process/EVENT-RESEARCH.md). The proposal's placement finding stands: this is the SCORING VENUE for the SI 2026/987 electricity VAT reversion, the first print in which the drag drops out of the annual comparison. WHAT THE INITIAL RESEARCH ADDED, AND IT RE-POINTS THE ENTRY'S WHOLE PURPOSE: the inherited attribution rule -- 'a UK April 2027 CPI print ~0.1pp hotter than a naive model is a TAX CHANGE, check the ONS contributions table' -- is arithmetically true and UNREADABLE AT THE HEADLINE. ONS series fetched 2026-09-09: the April year-on-year step versus March has averaged 0.594pp in absolute size across 2010-2026 (D7G7, n=17, median 0.5pp, max +2.0pp in 2022) and ALL SEVENTEEN exceeded the 0.098pp VAT step; April is also the largest month-on-month month of the UK year (D7BT, mean +0.677%, the biggest of all twelve, against an all-month mean absolute y/y step of 0.286pp). The VAT effect is one rounding unit on a number published to one decimal, in the noisiest month the UK calendar has. SECOND FINDING, WHICH CORRECTS A REGISTERED TEST ON THIS DATE: FT-uk-electricity-vat-reversion-2027-04-01-2 kills on the electricity index rising less than +4.0% m/m, which under full 5% pass-through requires the ex-VAT Ofgem cap to fall by LESS THAN 0.95% -- but price-cap-era April cap moves (D7DT, 2019-2026: +10.83, +0.16, +9.16, +40.62, -1.08, -10.26, +2.98, -8.42) have a median absolute size of 8.79%, 1.8x the VAT step. Replaying each of those eight Aprils under PERFECT pass-through, 3 of 8 (38%) score a false 'pass-through did not land' -- 2023, 2024 and 2026, the three most recent falling-cap Aprils. THE FIX THIS LANE CONTRIBUTES: GAS IS THE CONTROL. SI 2026/987 zero-rates domestic ELECTRICITY only; domestic gas stayed at 5% throughout, is priced by the SAME Ofgem cap on the SAME reset dates, and is published as the adjacent ONS item index 04.5.2 (D7DU). The electricity-minus-gas April month-on-month spread differences the cap out: excluding 2022's gas-specific energy crisis (-26.11pp, stated as a judgement) the spread is mean +0.28pp, sd 3.72pp, range -4.54 to +5.48 over seven years, against +5.28pp implied by full pass-through. Registered as FT-uk-cpi-2027-05-19-1 at a +2.0pp threshold: 29% false-positive on history, ~81% power -- error rates stated as numbers rather than as a prose caveat. THIRD FINDING, A SECOND MASKER IN THE SAME PRINT AND OPPOSITE IN SIGN: Easter Sunday 2027 is 28 March and 2026's was 5 April (computus), so April 2027 has no Easter and April 2026 did, pushing the annual rate DOWN while VAT pushes it UP. Air fares alone (07.3.3, D7EH, weight CJXW 5.2374/1000) have swung -14.3% to +27.4% month-on-month in April over 2015-2026 -- a headline contribution range of -0.075pp to +0.144pp, one half-percent-weight item spanning more than the entire VAT step. Graded MIXED on direction because the two nearest analogues disagree in sign (Easter 27 Mar 2016 gave -14.3%; Easter 31 Mar 2024 gave +6.5%): ONS's mid-month collection window decides as much as the Easter date, so the effect widens the band and cannot be netted out. FOURTH: the step's size band floor is lower than the parent lane drew it. CJXA fetched back to 2019 reads 17.0/18.0/19.0/20.0/27.0/23.3142/19.1488/20.6065 per 1000, giving 0.081-0.129pp rather than 0.091-0.129pp -- and 17.0 and 18.0 both sit OUTSIDE the parent's '19-27 per 1000' kill-switch band, a band that would fire on a weight this series has printed twice in eight years. Caveat recorded: pre-2023 weights publish to whole numbers, so the low floor is partly a precision artifact. CORRIDOR: seven tracked events within five days, and this is a 02:00 ET print on FOMC-MINUTES DAY (fomc-minutes-2027-05-19, 14:00 ET the same Wednesday), one day after vix-expiration-2027-05-18 and two days before opex-2027-05-21; for a book of eight US mega-caps the session belongs to the minutes. Tiered LOW: symbols: [], no UK listing, gilt or sterling instrument on this calendar, and no rates- or FX-keyed house playbook. THE VAT CONTENT IS CONTINGENT on the 2027-03-31 lapse (FT-uk-electricity-vat-reversion-2027-04-01-1, score by 2027-03-31); if the zero rate is extended or SI 2026/987 is annulled, this print keeps its date and loses its subject, and the ledger is re-scoped rather than dropped -- every finding above about READABILITY survives either way. Proposed onto the calendar in the same PR, all primary-verified 2026-09-09: uk-cpi-2027-02-17 (the January print that publishes the 2027 weights, the single resolution date for the size band), uk-cpi-2027-04-21 (the March print, the last drag-in month and the comparator this step is measured against), boe-decision-2027-06-17 (the first committee to see this print). Estimate widens caution only; it licenses no date-keyed action. Ledger: docs/research/events/uk-cpi-2027-05-19.md
